description: This file defines a class 'CoalescingFSEventsWatcher' responsible for watching file system events on specified paths, coalescing rapid changes to reduce duplicate notifications, and executing a callback when changes occur.

classes.name: CoalescingFSEventsWatcher
classes.description: A class that watches file system events on a set of paths, with event coalescing to avoid excessive notifications during rapid changes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a new watcher with specified paths, dispatch queue label, coalesce delay, notification criteria, and change callback.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Stops the watcher and releases resources upon deinitialization.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts monitoring the specified file system paths for changes.
